module: Saving and loading of "snapshots" (camera position and rotation) via the BeamNG online service (s2/v4/saveSnapshot and getSnapshot). A snapshot can be loaded from a URL scheme command (loadSnapshot). Emits the hooks onSnapshotCreate and onSnapshotLoad.
notes: BUG: the local function save(data) is a copy of load(data) (it repositions the camera and emits onSnapshotLoad). createSnapshot calls save() with no argument, so data is nil and data.camPos causes an error: snapshot creation is broken.
createSnapshot ignores its scheme and saveToServer parameters.
The ignoreStartupCmd field is kept across extension reloads (onSerialize returns true) so as not to replay the startup command.

ignoreStartupCmd.desc: If true, onSnapshotSchemeCommand ignores commands passed as a startup argument.

createSnapshot.desc: Intended to build the snapshot data, emit onSnapshotCreate(data) then send it to the server with core_online.apiCall('s2/v4/saveSnapshot'). Logs the id received or an error.

loadSnapshot.desc: Downloads the snapshot (s2/v4/getSnapshot) then switches to free camera, places the camera at data.camPos/camRot, emits onSnapshotLoad(data) and calls changeMap() if core_modmanager.isReady().

onSnapshotSchemeCommand.desc: Hook called when a URL scheme command arrives. For the "loadSnapshot" command, calls loadSnapshot(data). Ignored if isStartingArg and ignoreStartupCmd.

isStartingArg.desc: True if the command comes from the launch arguments.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a reload of the Lua extensions. Returns {ignoreStartupCmd = true}.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload. Restores ignoreStartupCmd.
